description: Projets d'implantation d'antenne téléphonie mobile is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Géo2France. Mobile phone antenna implementation projects for Orange, SFR, Bouygues and Free operators. Region: HIGH-DE-FRANCE. Departments: AISNE. Departments: NORD. Departments: OISE. Departments: NOT-DE-CALAIS. Departments: SUMMARY. Coverage: Géo2France. The portal shows the English title as "Mobile phone antenna implementation projects" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Géo2France. Its keywords include somme, oise, pas-de-calais, aisne, hauts-de-france, nord. The listing shows 1 download or service links in OGC:WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
